title: Срочно нужен врач  (A Doctor Is Needed Urgently)

segments.t: When the inspector is knocked unconscious at the foot of the stairs, Mikhail rushes into the kitchen begging Chef Barinov to find a doctor without calling an ambulance. Meanwhile, Max and Kostya put tape over their captive's eyes so he cannot hypnotize them.
Я говорю, срочно в лобби нужен доктор!
Потому что мы до конца не знаем его возможности.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'Step back! Misha, are you alive?' The plural past ending '-li' on the verb for 'stepped back' covers a group or the polite 'you'.
'God watches over drunkards.' In Russian, the idea of 'drunk people' flows naturally into 'protects' without extra filler words. Mikhail answers right away.
'A doctor is needed in the lobby.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'hotel lobby' and finishing on 'doctor'.
'In what sense, Misha?' The meaning hinges on 'which' working together with 'Misha' in spoken Russian.
Я говорю, срочно в лобби нужен доктор!
'I am saying, a doctor is urgently needed in the lobby!' An emphatic spoken line centered on the verb meaning 'speak'. Senya answers right away.
'Ah, chef, I understood you.' In Russian, the idea of 'and' flows naturally into 'understood' without extra filler words.
'The doctor will be there right now.' Senya anchors the line on 'Doctor', while 'will be' completes the thought.
'Thank you, hurry!' The grammar packs 'thank you' and 'faster' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Senya answers right away.
'Why did you tape his eyes shut?' Senya brings out the contrast between 'you' and 'why' in a few short words.
Потому что мы до конца не знаем его возможности.
'Because we do not fully know his capabilities.' The grammar packs 'that is why' and 'abilities' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'What if he hypnotizes with his eyes!' Notice how Russian expresses 'suddenly' and 'hypnotizes' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Senya answers right away.
'Got it.' Notice how Russian expresses 'understood' and 'understood' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Я говорю, срочно в лобби нужен доктор!
Потому что мы до конца не знаем его возможности.
And that finishes the scene in the kitchen and storage room. Notice how Mikhail urgently asks for a doctor in the lobby while Max explains why he taped the suspect's eyes. See you in the next scene.
